measurement: One-size Universal in two height profiles. Measure waist circumference around the trunk at a level midway between the lowest ribs and the top of the hip bones (upper iliac crest), standing. Slim (6 in.) for shorter torsos, Standard (8 in.) for average to longer torsos. Both fit waist 26 to 50 in. Plus size users can add an optional belt extension to extend the fit up to 70 in. Accommodates heights 5 ft 1 in. to 6 ft 5 in. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
